items.desc: Smart casual, for sure.

items.name: Green Shirt
items.desc: It hangs a bit loose, but it's good for being about the town.

items.name: Yesterday's Cabbage
items.desc: A tad stale, but decent for the price.

items.name: Stone
items.desc: Smooth stone, perfect for crafting.

items.name: Wood
items.desc: A chipping of wood, perfect for crafting.

items.name: Metal

items.name: Chicken
items.desc: CLUCK

items.name: Bear Meat
items.desc: Tough and gamey meat from a Bear

items.name: Gold
items.desc: Took more lives than Uranium...

items.name: Minty
items.desc: A cute lil' penguin called Minty. Awarded for participating in the Closed Beta.

items.name: Bandit's Cloak
items.desc: A long cloak used by petty bandits to hide their face in towns and conceal the weapons they carry. Allows you to blend in with Bandit enemies.

items.name: Oasis Spring Water

items.desc: A magical glowing crystal.

items.name: Scroll of Healing
items.desc: Causes all players around you to gain {INT} health for 3 seconds

items.name: Scroll of Good Fortune
items.desc:
Gives all players in an 8m radius a {INT}% chance of earning double loot for 60 seconds.

Does not stack.

items.name: Sharpened Letter Opener
items.desc: A short but somewhat sharpened knife designed for opening small parcels.

items.name: Horse
items.desc: A sturdy steed indeed.

items.name: Eagle
items.desc: He can't fly... yet

items.name: Pear
items.desc: A delicious and ripe Pear.

items.name: Routine Checkup T-Shirt
items.desc: It's just a white t-shirt.

items.name: King's Guard Sword
items.desc: Standard issue King's Guard Sword.

items.name: Essence of Corruption
items.desc: Extracted from a Corrupted creature.

items.name: Bottle of Poison
items.desc: Extracted from the fangs of a Cave Spider

items.name: Poison Dagger
items.desc: A short dagger with a layer of posion poured over. Owie.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.desc: A mostly sturdy shield.

items.name: Bandit's Blade
items.desc: A standard issue Bandit Blade. Hold up, who is making "standard issue" bandit items?

items.name: String
items.desc: A silky piece of string

items.name: Pelt
items.desc: A surprisingly clean pelt, harvested from an animal

items.name: Mage's Robe
items.desc: A robe worn by mages. Didn't you see what it was called?

items.name: Red Facemask
items.desc: A facemask worn by Bandits to cover their faces.

items.name: Leather Chestplate
items.desc: A mostly tough leather chestplate for protecting against even the most wowie of owie.

items.name: Leather Helmet
items.desc: A mostly tough leather helmet.

items.name: Leather Leggings
items.desc: A mostly tough leather leggings. Protection where you need it most!

items.name: Iron Helmet
items.desc: A sturdy, reinforced Iron Helmet

items.name: Iron Chestplate
items.desc: A sturdy, reinforced Iron Chestplate

items.name: Iron Leggings
items.desc: A sturdy, reinforced pair of Iron Leggings

items.name: Longsword
items.desc: A long sword masterfully crafted from Iron. Pretty heavy.

items.name: Battleaxe
items.desc: A hefty, heavy Axe used by barbarians for battle.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.desc: An iron pickaxe, perfect for harvesting resources.

items.name: Scroll of Fire
items.desc: Fire rises from the ground. Causes 1 - {INT}*3 damage to enemies within a 4m radius every second for 3 seconds.

items.name: Exotic Pickaxe
items.desc: A pickaxe crafted from Exotic material. As it hits a resource node it sends a shock of Mana-bound energy through the ground.

items.name: Exotic Material
items.desc: An immensely rare and precious material, which when combined with Mana sparks and comes to life.

items.name: Guardian's Helmet
items.desc: A helmet forged with Exotic Material and Mana

items.name: Guardian's Chestplate
items.desc: A Chestplate forged with Exotic Material and Mana

items.name: Guardian's Leggings
items.desc: Leggings forged with Exotic Material and Mana

items.name: Guardian's Axe
items.desc: A mighty axe forged with Exotic Material and Mana

items.name: Guardian's Blade
items.desc: An ultimately powerful weapon, possible only through the combination of Old and New World magic.

items.name: Guardian's Dagger
items.desc: A short but strong dagger forged with Mana and Exotic Material

items.name: Old World Crystal
items.desc:
The crystal glows with a strong aura. On touch you can see the faces of those that came before and that experienced its mighty power. Probably shouldn't touch it too much, eh?

Only 1 can be earned per mob per day

items.name: Earth Elementling
items.desc: Rescued from the stomach of a lizard. How it survived is beyond you, or me, or itself.

items.name: Scorpion
items.desc: Hidden behind a Rock this Scorpion first saw you as a threat but then as a friend. Now it refuses to not leave your side, threatening to pince you foes but backing away before the fight really starts.

items.name: Silver Dragonling
items.desc: This baby Dragon seems to have been created by Mana during a particularly fierce fight. Now it is bound to your soul for all eternity.

items.name: Iron Shield
items.desc: A sturdy shield, crafted from Iron.

items.name: Scroll of Protection
items.desc: A spell that creates a semi-physical barrier around your allies. Increases DEF in a 4m radius by {INT} for 12 seconds.

items.name: Blank Scroll
items.desc: A blank scroll, brimming with magical energy. Can be used in crafting to create spells.

items.name: Recovery
items.desc: Recovers {STA} HP every second for 3 seconds

items.name: Boat
items.desc: A mighty and sturdy Fishing Boat, allowing you to  set sail from any water-adjacent land. Not sure how it fits in your pocket, though.

items.name: Eye Patch
items.desc: Ahoy! A wonderful eyepatch that'll help ye see in th' darkest o' nights at sea.

items.name: Pirate Ship Fragment
items.desc: Ahoy! This here chip o' wood fell off a gentleman o' fortune ship. I wonder if gatherin' enough o' them would allow ye to fly the black sails, too?

items.name: Pirate Boat
items.desc: Flyin' the black sails won't lend ye much jolly will, but it'll keep the gentlemen o' fortune off yer aft fer sure. Prevents Pirates from attacking you.

items.name: Corrupted Steed
items.desc: An even sturdier steed, indeed. Faint whispers of an ancient language can be heard if you listen closely... hmm, I wouldn't about it too much. Fast horse go brrr

items.name: Permafrost Report
items.desc: A log book, covered in dried blood.

items.name: Essence of Frost
items.desc: Within The Permafrost the Essence of the eternal cold sometimes manifests itself in strange ways. This appears to be a manifestation of the cold itself.

items.name: Frost Cloud
items.desc: An icy, permanently cold cloud of frost. So thick is the cold within that it allows a person to ride it as it moves. Best bring a heated saddle with his one.

items.name: Ice-Touched Pickaxe
items.desc: A pickaxe embued with the spirit of the Permafrost. It strikes harshly, and coldly.

items.name: Frosty Brew Recipe
items.desc: A clearly printed recipe on how to create Bartender Fred II's Frosty Brew.

items.name: Frosty Brew
items.desc: A delicious alcoholic beverage that never loses its cool. Grants one heightened intelligence for a moment or two (or, at least, they THINK that they have heightened intelligence).

items.name: Hero's Helmet
items.desc: The ultimate in head-based cranium protection.

items.name: Hero's Chestplate
items.desc: The ultimate in chest-based pectoral protection.

items.name: Hero's Leggings
items.desc: The ultimate in leg-based calf protection.

items.name: Hero's Shield
items.desc: The ultimate in... uh... shield-based protection? Sure. That works.

items.name: Hero's Dagger
items.desc: A blade forged in fire and blood. Alternatively, some Old World Crystals and a Guardian's Dagger. Not to get all dramatic on you.

items.name: Apprentice's Note
items.desc: Apparently this'll give you the apprentice's slot on the apprenticeship. Is it a scam? Maybe. Worth finding out? Eh...

items.name: Box of Gear
items.desc: Better deliver this to Riverbridge.

items.name: Rose Pickaxe
items.desc: An axe that is coated with some pinkish substance.

items.name: Fire Cloud
items.desc: Might burn a little, but this impressive bout of eternal fire is literally lighter than air.

items.name: Chair
items.desc: A stable, sturdy chair.

items.name: Barrel
items.desc: A barrel. What's it filled with? Who knows...

items.name: Bedroll
items.desc: Gotta sleep! And now you can...

items.name: Plant
items.desc: Mmmm, a breath of fresh air.

items.name: Campfire
items.desc: Warm and cozy. Lovely!

items.name: Stone Floor
items.desc: A nice - although slightly cold to the touch - stone floor.

items.name: Wood Floor
items.desc: A nice - although slightly squeaky to the step - wood floor.

items.name: Stone Wall
items.desc: A sturdy stone wall.

items.name: John, Please Return Home
items.desc: A sealed letter given to you by someone in Shieldbreak Mine. You ought to find this 'John' rather than reading video game tooltips.

items.name: Guardian's Staff
items.desc: An ultimately powerful weapon, possible only through the combination of Old and New World magic.

items.name: Wizard's Walking Staff
items.desc: A long wooden stick with a faint magical glow.

items.name: Bandit's Staff
items.desc: A walking stick that's been sanded down to smoothness with a glowing green crystal affixed to its end.

items.name: Metal Ore
items.desc: Metal Ore. Probably worth taking this to a forge!

items.name: Exotic Ore
items.desc: Exotic Ore. Probably worth taking this to a forge!

items.name: Exotic Robe
items.desc: This robe sparkles with magical properties.

items.name: Earth Elementling
items.desc: Fortunately this guy doesn't babble on quite as much as his peers.

items.name: Bunny Ears
items.desc: Celebrate Jesus's return in style with these... rabbit ears? Wait, what?

items.name: Bunny Shirt
items.desc: You know I'm really not sure what rabbits have to do with Jesus returning from the grave. Any ideas?

items.name: Bunny Pants
items.desc: AH! NEW LIFE! It's about REBIRTH and Rabbits produce lots of offspring. Tentative but, whatever, it'll do.

items.name: Whirlwind
items.desc: You turn into a raging whirlwind of fire for 4 seconds, moving at 10m/s and knocking back any enemies in your path.

items.name: Studded Helmet
items.desc: A studded helmet, rough to the touch.

items.name: Studded Chestplate
items.desc: A studded chestplate, rough to the touch.

items.name: Studded Leggings
items.desc: Studded leggings, rough to the touch.

items.name: Easter Egg
items.desc: Yummy and chocolatey, but better used for crafting!

items.name: Cow
items.desc: Mooooooo

items.name: Black Bear
items.desc: A bit rough, but he's fast!

items.name: Hero's Blade
items.desc: A phenomenally powerful weapon wieldable only by the strongest battle-hardened warriors.

items.name: Bone Hurting Juice
items.desc: Pour on the ground to injure skeletons. 'Oof ouch owie, my bones' ~ The Skeleton King

items.name: Bone Fragment
items.desc: A rough fragment of bone, pulled from the corpse of a reanimated skeleton.

items.name: Green Ooze
items.desc: An oozing green liquid of some sort. It quivers with life in your hand.

items.name: Oozing Bone Juice
items.desc: Dripping with fragments of bone.

items.name: Master Wizard's Cloak
items.desc: This cloak sparkles with magical properties.

items.name: Bone Sword
items.desc: A sword infused with metal and bone, stolen from the Skeleton King's stash.

items.name: Skeleton's Head
items.desc: A trophy from your adventures fighting the Skeleton King.

items.name: Stoic Reputation
items.desc: Reputation earned for the Stoic Order.

items.name: Mage Reputation
items.desc: Reputation earned for the Mage Order.

items.name: Warrior Reputation
items.desc: Reputation earned for the Warrior Order.

items.name: Pumpkin Head
items.desc: A spooky pumpkin helmet, freshly picked from Mr Bones Pumpkin Patch!

items.name: Slasher Pants
items.desc: A dark piece of cloth formerly worn by a terrible killer. Hey, they sound just like you!

items.name: Slasher Jacket
items.desc: A dark piece of cloth formerly worn by a terrible killer. Hey, they sound just like you!

items.name: Coveted Candy
items.desc: An APPLE? How is that CANDY? I'd rather give trade this with the BONIES than eat this myself. YUCK.

items.name: Bat
items.desc: What a cute little spooky bitey guy.

items.name: The Tribrawlers Cup
items.desc: *The chalice pulses with energy* Touching this didn't teleport you anywhere, so that's at least 1 step towards this obvious parody being fair use.

items.name: Old Man's Walking Staff
items.desc: Well... he seemed to think it was powerful. Combined with some 'magical chalice' is said to make it grow in power. What a crazy old man.

items.name: Hero's Staff
items.desc: A phenomenally powerful staff, wieldable only through a combination of ancient & modern magic.

items.name: Master Blade of Fire
items.desc: A firey blade that explodes on impact, causing damage to all nearby enemies.

items.name: Master Trident of the Wizard
items.desc: A betwitched trident that - instead of causing damage - returns all potential damage to the wielder as mana

items.name: Scroll of Allied Protection
items.desc: A spell that creates a semi-physical barrier around your allies. Increases DEF in a 8m radius by 25 for 30 seconds.

items.name: Scroll of Superior Intellect
items.desc: A scroll containing EVEN MORE knowledge of the oasis. Increases INT in a 8m radius by {INT}*2 for 120 seconds. Doesn't stack with other INT auras.

items.name: White Horse
items.desc: A sturdier steed than all the steeds you ever did see, indeed.

items.name: Red Boat
items.desc: The red marks make it sail faster.

items.name: Red Cloth
items.desc: Wow! This dazzling red cloak is large enough to use as a ship's sail. Hmm...

items.name: Fishing Rod
items.desc: It can't be used for hitting things, but it might be useful if thrown into the ocean.

items.name: Crystal Fragment
items.desc: The crystal glows with a weaker aura than expected. On touch you can see sort of, like, vague shapes and stuff.

quests.title: Fred's Pest Problem
quests.desc: Fred needs you to kill spiders in the forest that his beer garden backs onto.

quests.title: Fred's Pest Problem Pt 2
quests.desc: Fred needs you to gather some Bottles of Poison from Poison Spiders in the forest that his beer garden backs onto.

quests.title: Need For Steed
quests.desc: Carus needs you to slay Corrupted Steed in Westlum and return with 5x Essence of Corruption

quests.title: 2 Need 2 Speed
quests.desc: Carus needs you to slay Corrupted Steed in Westlum and return with 50x Essense of Corruption

quests.title: The Night Before
quests.desc: After a rather rowdy night on the town you've been summoned by Captain Vincent in the Barracks.

quests.title: The Thing with the Permafrost
quests.desc: Bartender Fred II wants you to investigate the lack of reporting he's had from his Permafrost mine, and try to locate the company's Log Book.

quests.title: The Thing with the Bartender
quests.desc: With his staff long dead Bartender Fred II needs you to gather Essence of Frost.

quests.title: The Thing Itself
quests.desc: It's time to take the fight directly to the source of the Permafrost: the Entity of Frost itself.

quests.title: Special Reserves
quests.desc: You've been asked to take out the pesky Bandits that keep stealing the Farmer's SPECIAL RESERVE food.

quests.title: The Apprentice
quests.desc: You've been given a note to take over as a Blacksmith's Apprentice. Marketing scheme or friend in need? Who knows.

quests.title: The Apprentice Pt II
quests.desc: For the first part of your Blacksmithing Apprenticeship you're needed to create a Letter Opener.

quests.title: The Apprentice Pt III
quests.desc: For the second part of your Blacksmithing Apprenticeship you're needed to create some Leather Pants.

quests.title: The Apprentice Pt IV
quests.desc: For the third part of your Blacksmithing Apprenticeship you're needed to create a Wooden Shield.

quests.title: The Apprentice Pt V
quests.desc: For the final part of your Blacksmithing Apprenticeship you're needed to... uh... deliver an order to a Priest in Riverbridge. NOTE: Riverbridge will be accessible in a future update.

quests.title: The Apprentice Pt V
quests.desc: For the final part of your Blacksmithing Apprenticeship you're needed to... uh... deliver an order to a Priest in Riverbridge.

quests.title: Face The Fire
quests.desc: You've been asked to take out the Fire Phoenix.

quests.title: Saving Miner John
quests.desc: You've been asked to locate John, a miner who uncovered some sort of mystery of 'the sun God'. His sister has given you a letter to return to him, instructing you to head 'North in the mine'.

quests.title: Clearing a Path
quests.desc: Miner John has asked you to kill Mystic Beings in Elodine's Gift to buy him the time to run back through the forest and find his way home.

quests.title: The Village Weirdos
quests.desc: Head North to the village in Elodine's Gift and give them the letter John's sister gave to him, letting them know that John has gone home.

quests.title: The Old Village
quests.desc: Head South and 'set free' the ghosts of the former townsfolk.

quests.title: Ooze Control
quests.desc: A terribly frightened skeleton wants you to kill the Ooze monster.

npc-priest-1.title: Hello, brother. How may I bless you today?

options.text: Forgive me Father, for I have sinned.

npc-priest-2.title: Rumours? I wouldn't dabble in such affairs personally.

npc-priest-3.title: Bless you, child. You need not confess to me: confess before God and your sins will be forgiven.

options.text: How is the field life treating you?

npc-farm-2.title: Field... life? OH. Farming. Aye. Peaceful, for the most part.

options.text: Peaceful isn't really my cup of tea, personally.

npc-farm-3.title: 'Spare'? That isn't really how my job works. If you want something fresh then you've gotta spend the coin. Simple as.

options.text: I get that. Still hungry though.

npc-farm-4.title: Aye. Living just outside the walls ain't much safer than living outside the protection of the King's Guard completely. When you consider the number of mouths to feed and this being the closest farm to the town... well, it'd be nice if I felt safer.

options.text: There are a few Guards stationed nearby. Don't they help?

npc-farm-5.title: Heh. I was once an adventurer like you. *Scratches his knee* Then I found a love for the simple life.

options.text: Oh yeah? Maybe one day that'll be me..

npc-farm-6.title: Ugh, go on then. Here's a bit of what I saved back for my dinner.

npc-farm-8.title: PEH! They're all for show. Believe me. They nod off at night and that's when the bandits start their assaults. PEH.

npc-farm-9.title: Don't worry yourself with it. What we really need are better trained guards, or some sort of community voluntary alternative. Defund em, that's what I say.

options.text: Re-thinking our guard system so that it can better support our community? That belief is a bit too radical for me...
Famished mate! What you got cooking?

npc-bartender-2.title: Nothing behind bar but I do need SOMETHING taken care of that might interest you.

npc-bartender-3.title: Squall's End Brew tickle your fancy? Fresh out the keg! Just 5 gold pieces.

npc-bartender-5.title: My patrons have been complaining about a foul smell in the corner of my beer garden. We back off onto a forest and I'd go and look myself but the spiders have been getting reaaal viscious looking.

options.text: How long has this been going on for?

npc-bartender-8.title: Hot off the Hog Roast... well, Bear roast. Enjoy!

options.text: How big can a spider really be?
Big man like yourself... why haven't you just gone and squished em?

npc-bartender-10.title: A few days now. At first I thought it were the customers themselves but... nope, there's definitely something off.

npc-bartender-11.title: Er, well, no. News like that isn't great for business and as you know every monster report is made public knowledge.

options.text: I see. So how big are these spiders?

npc-bartender-12.title: THEY'RE BIG! We aren't talking about no cup and paper throw away insects here.

options.text: Technically spiders are arachnids, not insects.
Let me guess: you want me to kill them?

npc-bartender-13.title: BIG MAN!?? My wife cooks DELICIOUS pies. What am I meant to do, just not eat them? Big man. The cheek.

options.text: Sure she does. So these spiders are pretty big then?

npc-bartender-14.title: Do you want this job or not? Stop being so rude.

npc-desert-2.title: No need to be hesitant, my friend. You are safe here, outside of the grip of the King's Guard.

options.text: I see... so where am I?

npc-desert-3.title: We are a group of individuals who transcended from the material world that the King and his minions attempt to perpetuate. We're... pure at heart, and fair.

options.text: What do you mean by Material?

npc-desert-4.title: Indeed. We reject the idea of peace through enforcement. We prefer peace through... well, peace.

options.text: So if I was to try and rob you..

npc-desert-5.title: We take only what we need and give more than we take. No transaction: no gold, no heirachy. There is a mutual understanding.

options.text: Wow! And what of the greedy?
So if I was to try and rob you..

npc-desert-6.title: Things in our world contain only the value that you personally prescribe to them. By removing the transaction the material becomes transcendent: it belongs to everyone rather than an individual.

options.text: So if I was to try and rob you..

npc-desert-7.title: HAHA! The idea of theft only exists because of the false values that you bestow upon the items being taken. Have everything, my friend, take it all!!

npc-desert-8.title: Greed - like theft - is only pertinent if YOU give it pertinence. Are you greedy? Are you lazy? Does it matter? Why don't we allow for humans to just be... humans...

npc-desert-9.title: Stay awhile, my friend. Speak to the others. You might find that you like our way of life.

options.text: I have a question about your community

npc-desert-transcendence-4.title: I think... long and hard... and then I... explain... things...

npc-desert-transcendence-5.title: Ha... ha... ha... a mighty joke...

options.text: Theres more where that came from...

npc-desert-transcendence-6.title: Hmmm... sometimes I bottle water... ensure it is pure... and distribute it...

npc-desert-transcendence-7.title: That may be... what your kind... would call it... do you want to know a secret?

npc-desert-transcendence-8.title: You have been... exceptionally patient... with... ... ... me... Take this scroll... it is the source... of my knowledge...

npc-desert-ferocious-1.title: A stranger comes to town. How are you?

options.text: I have a question about your community

npc-desert-ferocious-2.title: Hehe, my apologies: a friend returns. I see that you've been speaking to Transcendence.

options.text: Your names are a tad peculier
The man by the oasis? He is a strange one...

npc-desert-ferocious-3.title: Ooh, by all means, ask away.

options.text: Whats the deal with your names?
I see no anvil... do you not have weapons?

npc-desert-ferocious-4.title: Hah! We choose our own names out here and shed the names we were assigned at birth. Mayhaps that leaves us with peculier monikers by outsider standards.

options.text: Can I choose my own name?
I see no anvil... do you not have weapons?

npc-desert-ferocious-5.title: Now, now: he - like all of us - once felt dissilusioned by the world at large. Transcendence is older and the scars from the material world show clear as day... but he is nonetheless the wisest of us.

options.text: Whats the deal with your names?
I see no anvil... do you not have weapons?
But what about Bandits or Monsters?

npc-desert-ferocious-7.title: Of course you can! If you take nothing else away from your visit here then take this: the so-called REAL world is all about fictional hierachy. Call yourself what you want... What works best for you... and don't let anyone call you otherwise.

options.text: I see no anvil... do you not have weapons?

npc-desert-ferocious-8.title: Bandits only attack King's Guard territory because they've been exiled, often for exceedingly petty crimes. They approach us for food and drink only when they need it, and protect us from the monsters outside.

options.text: Wow... thats a lot to think about

npc-desert-ferocious-9.title: Violent only to the perpetuators of violence.

options.text: They attack civilians for gold. You are so naive.
Hmm... I suppose thats right. But theyve been less than friendly towards me.

npc-desert-ferocious-10.title: Hm. Here, take this. Wear it around them as a signal of friendship and empathy and I BET they leave you be.

npc-desert-ferocious-11.title: No. Your perception is warped by the violence that you yourself have witnessed. But death and pain is the end to suffering, not the perpetuator of it.

options.text: You are wrong. I am done with this conversation.

wilderness-warning-sign.title: WARNING: You are about to enter the Wilderness. The rulings of the King's Guard do not apply within and you may be attacked at any time.

options.text: That sign cant stop me because I cant read

wilderness-pub-sign.title: The Wilderness Inn. Leave your weapons at the door.

benny.title: Benny Harvey. RIP. Miss you big man. Gone but not forgotten.

options.text: Who is Benny Harvey? Eh, who cares.

farmer-north-2.title: Good on ye. Lookin fer work?

farmer-north-3.title: Heh, put off the whole big man act with me lad. Are you King's Guard or nah?

farmer-north-4.title: These Bandits have set up camp just north of us. I don't mind that sort but they keep stealing my special reserve food.

options.text: What do you want me to do about it?

farmer-north-5.title: So that letter I sent 3 months ago about the Bandits? What's being done?

options.text: Oh, uh, yeah. Im looking into that right now actually.

farmer-north-6.title: AYE! Gotta save the good stuff back fer your own, you know? And they keep nicking it.

farmer-north-8.title: Bigger problems than Squal's End's supply chain? Peh. If you say so.

options.text: What do you expect us to do?

dancing-man-2.title: No surprise after the night you had, friend!

dancing-man-3.title: Not surprised you remember so little of it, either!

options.text: Sorry mate, can you just tell me what happened?

dancing-man-4.title: You drank the entire pub out of beer, then started rambling about some Bandit Alliance or something.

options.text: I do not remember a thing. Bandit Alliance?

dancing-man-5.title: BANDIT ALLIANCE! Something about a vision. Caught the attention of the whole Barracks. In fact Captain Vincent himself wants a word with you.

dancing-man-6.title: Oh dear oh dear oh dear. OH DEAR! Now Captain Vincent wants a word with you! OH DEAR!

dancing-man-7.title: ... oh dear. You really have lost your memory. Vincent is the head of the King's Guard presence in Squall's End.

dancing-man-8.title: Ah, to be young and having to face the ramifications of your own actions. Embrace it. And if it sucks, then you can always have this to look forward to afterwards.

dancing-man-9.title: You'll find Vincent in the barracks. I wouldn't keep him waiting. Now get off the beach so I can finish my dance! OowoooooOoowwwooo

squall-man-1.title: Brave of you to show your face around here. I'd have been embarrased for days!

vincent-1.title: I wondered when you would awaken.

vincent-2.title: It's no bother. I just hope you're feeling okay today. Are you?

options.text: Wait. Am I not in trouble?
Mostly. Shaken by waking up to this strange dancing man.

vincent-3.title: Good heavens no! This is just a routine check up. Like we, er, do on all of our... uh... citizens.

options.text: So this has nothing to do with a Bandit Alliance?

vincent-4.title: A dancing man, eh? Did he... say anything?

vincent-5.title: Yes yes! A routine check up! In fact!! Here is your ROUTINE CHECKUP SHIRT.

options.text: This is just a white shirt.

vincent-6.title: A Bandit Alliance? Nah. I don't reckon that has any weight to it.

options.text: But why would I be yelling about it?

vincent-7.title: Oh goodie! Be gone now, much work to do.

options.text: Well... he did mention a Bandit Alliance?

vincent-8.title: JUST a white shirt? No chance! That is a LIMITED EDITION ROUTINE CHECK UP white shirt. You won't find many with that on.

options.text: So can we talk about the Bandit Alliance?

vincent-9.title: YOU ARE MOST WELCOME. Leave now. Much work to do and that.

options.text: Hold up. What is this Bandit Alliance I was jabbering on about?

vincent-10.title: You were drunk! You probably invented the whole concept yourself.

options.text: What are you hiding from me and why?

vincent-11.title: Listen kid. Here's the bottom line: you're going to drop this or I'm going to get angry. Your choice.

options.text: No. Not this easily. What is going on?

vincent-12.title: NOTHING. IS. GOING. ON. DROP IT.

vincent-13.title: Bribing the King's Guard? ... Okay. Deal. Have it.

wep-sell-2.title: Fancy this? A +10 Sword. Yours for just 200 Gold.

wep-sell-3.title: Err... are you actually King's Guard?

wep-sell-5.title: I'll take your word for it. Employee discount applied... this +10 Sword. Yours for just 175 Gold.

blacksmith-1.title: Anywhere an Anvil lies a weapon may be craft!

blacksmith-2.title: Place your items on the Anvil and smash the hammer down to create something new.

blacksmith-3.title: Try combining 1 wood with 2 stone, or 1 wood with 2 metal.

blacksmith-4.title: Forging new items is a path of trial and error. Sometimes the item you create will be one of kind and unique: these items are harder to create, and so are less likely to be forged.

beta-soon.title: ... which by my calculations means tha- UH... I mean WOW fantasty MAGIC and stuff HOW did these BARRELS get here? Maybe they'll clear of their own accord soon?

horse.title: *This creature is frozen in fear, but observes you curiously*

carus-1.title: You made it through the Corrupted ones? Wow.

carus-2.title: My beautiful horses... our only source of water was corrupted by some putrid darkness and those that drank from it became evil and twisted.

options.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

carus-3.title: A life of inflicting suffering is no life for such majestic beings. Slay them and extract the corruption and I can study this compound and perhaps devise a cure. 5 should do the trick.

carus-4.title: Wow! Thank you. How can I ever repay you? ... Wait ... that's it! Do you want one of my remaining horses? They are immensely loyal and will help you get to where you need to be in no time at all.

npc-bartender-15.title: Bless you! Kill a few of them then come back to me. That'd be most useful.

options.text: A kill quest eh? How original.

npc-bartender-16.title: You did it!? Marvelous! Thank you! Some free beers and gold of gratitude on me. Say... are you up to another task?

npc-bartender-17.title: Something like that. You see our brew takes a very special type of recipe to create that can only be harvested from the glands of Poison Spider Fangs. Would you care to extract some for me?

options.text: Poison Spiders eh? You got it.
Let me get back to you on that one.

npc-bartender-19.title: What a legend you are! Thank you. We'll be able to make beer for weeks with this.

carus-6.title: Well... I suppose it might be worth taking a deeper look? Here, if you can get me 50 extractions of this vile material then I may be able to turn the Corrupt back to Good.

carus-7.title: YOU'LL DO IT!? You are a friend to all who call Nature their home. Thank you.

carus-5.title: Here. You have done great things. Take care of her!

options.text: Is there anything else I can do?

carus-8.title: Hero of Horse-kind! Thank you for your service. Now I just need to combine this with that and... YES! I have HEALED ONE! He seems awfully loyal to you.

wilderness-bartender-1.title: Hello there! Here you are free to be merry. Leave the violence at the door.

wilderness-bartender-2.title: Says thou whomst dredges through the wilderness.

options.text: I do what I need to survive thank you very much.
Alright. So I like to get my blade dirty. And what?

wilderness-bartender-3.title: I do indeed have some work that may interest you. Our Ale is made using crystals harvested from the Permafrost.

options.text: Let me guess: you want me to get you some?

wilderness-bartender-4.title: Now, now: I serve only the battle-hardy. I don't judge a violent person. In fact, I praise them! Protector of the realm you are!

options.text: Right... and is there anything you might need of a battle-hardy individual?

wilderness-bartender-5.title: Not quite. I have my own private mining operation set up, you see... but I haven't heard from them for weeks. My supplies are running low.

wilderness-bartender-6.title: They are meant to issue a report every week. But I've heard nothing. Would you be so kind as to seek out this report? Perhaps they were unable to travel due to a storm...

wilderness-bartender-7.title: Wonderful! Thank you! Bring the report back to me if you find it.

permafrost-report.title: *This book is covered in dried blood. The words 'Permafrost Mine Report' are written on the cover.*

permafrost-report-1.title: I'm going to hide this book when I'm finished. If none of us make it, at least there'll be some kind of record.

permafrost-report-3.title: The storm's been hitting us hard now for... 48 hours.. We still have nothing to go on.

permafrost-report-4.title: One other thing: I think it rips through your clothes when it takes you over... We found some shredded longjohns but the nametag was missing... it could be anybody's...

permafrost-report-5.title: Nobody trusts anybody now, and we're all very tired... there's nothing more I can do, just wait...

permafrost-report-6.title: *There is nothing else written in the book.*

wilderness-bartender-8.title: *Fred skims through the log* Oh no... this is terrible...

options.text: Yeah. It sounds like they had a rough time.

wilderness-bartender-9.title: Not that. This means that I won't be getting another shipment in. I'M RUINED!!

options.text: Anything I can do to help?

wilderness-bartender-10.title: They'd warned me of SOMETHING in the depths of our little mine but I didn't want to cease operation... I couldn't...

options.text: So you chose their lives over a loss of profit?

wilderness-bartender-11.title: LOOK. When you run a business you have to make tough decisions. This was one of many I've had to take. I feel no guilt.

options.text: Typical. Is there anything I can do?
Just wait until the Kings Guard hears of this!

wilderness-bartender-12.title: I can't run the risk of losing my profit. This is the only bar that the outlaws of The Wilderness visit. Could you... get me some Essence of Frost?

wilderness-bartender-13.title: NO. PLEASE. THEY'LL CLAIM THE BAR FOR THEIR OWN. Nothing would turn my regular patrons off more than that...

options.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
That is the price that you pay.

wilderness-bartender-14.title: Thank you, again, sincerely. I will pay you well.

wilderness-bartender-15.title: Wonderful! Now my operation need not lose profit. I must admit, though, I'm feeling a twinge of guilt about my former staff...

wilderness-bartender-16.title: From what you've described it sounds like their reposessed bodies are out there... rotting away...

options.text: I smell a kill quest coming...

wilderness-bartender-17.title: I might not have been truthful before. Uh, I have to admit something...

wilderness-bartender-18.title: So, uh, I actually do know what happened. Deep in the mines is an... entity... of sorts. It's the cause of the Permafrost.

wilderness-bartender-19.title: Sadly not. The Permafrost was good for business, so, I stuck with it. For 10 years.

wilderness-bartender-20.title: Look. I am not able to kill it. My staff weren't either. But YOU... you may be able...

wilderness-bartender-21.title: What a legend you are! Thank you. Report back to me when it's done and I will reward you well.

wilderness-bartender-22.title: It is done. Thank you. My Frosty Brew recipe is yours and you have my permission to make it 100 times.

options.text: So will the Permafrost begin to recede?
You know what? I do not want to know.

wilderness-bartender-24.title: So that may not have been the SOURCE of the Permafrost, per say, but a manifestation of it that was... weakening my profits.

options.text: So it was all about the money afterall. Shocker.

farmer-north-7.title: So I'm thinking you go up there and rustle a few feathers, aye? Take a few of em' out. No doubt they're watching us right this second. You speak to me then go and cause some havoc... they'll leave me alone for sure.

farmer-north-11.title: You don't understand my special reserve food then, clearly! This is worth a hundred human souls. Are you gonna help or nah?

farmer-north-accept.title: HAHA! Knew you'd come around. Go take out a few of em' then come back to me.

farmer-north-13.title: Wahey! Yer' actually came through. Wonderful work. Just wonderful.

npc-bartender-18.title: Excellent! Gather 3 bottles and bring them back to me post-haste.

options.text: I only come from Squalls. Hardly an outsider.

riverbridge-citizen-2.title: It's the guards, you see... the King's Guard sent some troops who I suppose were meant to help with the whole Foglands situation but they, uh, had some other ideas...

options.text: Uh oh. What did they ACTUALLY do?

riverbridge-citizen-3.title: Right, right, yes, of course, I didn't mean to offend. It's just that we're in a bit of a situation right now and it's fantastic to see a fresh face.

riverbridge-citizen-4.title: The marshes to the West of the village. We call them The Foglands. Weird place, that, filled with bizarre creatures. The issue is that the marshes have been... expanding.

riverbridge-citizen-5.title: There was one operation they attempted, but they lost many... only a third of the unit returned. Ever since then they've been drinking themselves into a stupor.

riverbridge-citizen-6.title: Yes! Expanding! Around a meter a day. It's almost up to our chapel, now... not that that's seeing much use.

npc-bartender-4.title: Same old, same old: Bear Steak. 15 gold pieces. You fancy?

options.text: Tough and gamey, just how I like it!

enchant-concern-1.title: That entity is a mysterious thing. I wouldn't go near it, personally.

enchant-concern-2.title: I'm ready. I'm ready. I'm ready... I'm not ready...

enchant-concern-3.title: I dare not go any closer. The townsfolk are obsessed with this... THING... but not me. It's unholy, and that means it's got to be watched. 24 hours a day.

enchant-concern-4.title: HEY! I'm HIDING. You're gonna give my spot away!!

enchant-kid-2.title: ... I guess not. You won't tell my parents, will you? PLEASE DON'T.

options.text: Your secret is safe. So what is that thing?

enchant-kid-3.title: Heh. The grown-ups don't know, but we think it makes everyone forget about you. Pretty handy... I might use it if my parents find out I sneak out at night.

enchant-concern-5.title: Hehehe, they don't want to know what this thing is! Scholars!? PEH. Morons.

enchant-dance-1.title: But OF COURSE. Simple observation. It makes people forget about you: a 2nd chance!

enchant-dance-2.title: I imagine you get something in return. A soul sacrifice, for a soul improvement!

enchant-dance-3.title: Our dimension is one of many! When you use the entity you are transported into a new reality. You never even existed in this one! Wonderful stuff.

enchant-concern-6.title: You made it! Congratulations. Others have been... not so lucky.

quall-recruiter-3.title: I'm getting to it. Chill out.

quall-recruiter-4.title: You take this note to the Blacksmith and he'll let you take my place as an apprentice, no doubt!

quall-recruiter-5.title: Look. It wasn't for me. But it might be for you? You seem like the adventuring type. You'll need to travel off to distant mines and fight monsters and all of that stuff. Sound good?

quall-recruiter-2.title: REALLY!? I was told that Blacksmithing was a path to glory and riches. Nah. Boring. Spend most of my time mining.

options.text: Sounds more like moaning than offering work.
So? Can I be an apprentice?

blacksmith-apprentice-2.title: Er... sure. Want to... learn to make stuff?

options.text: Yes! How do I make things?

blacksmith-apprentice-3.title: Nah. I'd never engage in Guerilla Marketing by pretending to have a disgruntled apprentice offer you up a fake contract to become an apprentice. Never.

blacksmith-apprentice-4.title: PROFESSIONAL HAT TIME! Welcome to the Blacksmith's Apprenticeship programme. Your first task: create a Letter Opener by combining 2 Rocks and 1 Wood.

blacksmith-apprentice-5.title: WONDERFUL! I'll just... put that in this box marked 'to ship'. Don't worry about that.

blacksmith-apprentice-6.title: Hmmm... *checks a sheet of paper titled 'OVERDUE ORDERS'* ... how about some FANCY PANTS Leather Leggings?

blacksmith-apprentice-7.title: MARVELLOUS STUFF. We're really on a roll here! We make a great TEAM.

options.text: Are you going to maybe lift a finger to help?

blacksmith-apprentice-8.title: I'm doing the marketing work! The REAL meat of the business! You create the product and I, like, mark it as complete and put it in a box and stuff.

blacksmith-apprentice-9.title: A Wooden Shield would be good. Yes yes yes.

blacksmith-apprentice-10.title: Viola! The order is ful- UH, I MEAN, THE APPRENTICE PROGRAMME IS COMPLETE.  I have one small favour left to ask of you...

options.text: Lemme guess: I need to deliver your order?

phoenix-dancer-1.title: Hehehe, all this dancing in the sun is making me break a sweat! Or is that the Fire Phoenix above me?

options.text: Wait. How did you get here?

phoenix-dancer-2.title: Whichever or BOTHever the sweat is indeed dripping, but alas I will never stop my fancy dance!

options.text: Can I get you some water?
Wait. How did you get here?

phoenix-dancer-3.title: I am one with the creatures, and they are one with me! The Eagles of Phoenix Rest do not attack me... although that Firey one is getting a bit out of hand.

options.text: Is he now? Can I help?

phoenix-dancer-4.title: The only help I need is rest from the heat! Now I would never suggest killing a creature - but - if the heat went down a tad that'd be mighty handy.

phoenix-dancer-5.title: I don't know how you did it, but I am COOL. Take a fancy pants axe as a reward.

blacksmith-apprentice-11.title: I TOLD YOU WE WERE A GOOD TEAM! Yes. That'd be ace! It's needed in Riverbridge, a village to the south west of Squall's End. Follow the Westlum trail out of Bartender Fred's beer garden and you'll find it.

options.text: Exploiting an apprentice for free labour! Woo!!

elodine-gift-1.title: Are you an adventurer? Can you help me?

elodine-gift-2.title: Its my brother... he'd been ranting about some 'vision of the Sun God' and a place that was an imprint of... a memory of... the Forest?

options.text: Did you file a missing persons report?

elodine-gift-3.title: The Great Northern Forest! Where we all once came from and from where we will all once return. Might be worth hitting the history books, aye?

options.text: Ah yes... THAT Forest... of course...
Did you file a missing persons report?

elodine-gift-4.title: We're a mining colony. The King's Guard aren't interested in us as individuals, only as mining profits. One miner down, another takes their place.

elodine-gift-5.title: He told me to find him 'North in the Mine' but I'm no adventurer: I can't head in there myself. Would you? Find him, give him this letter, get him to come home...

elodine-john-1.title: HEY! Don't make too much sound... you'll attract those THINGS.

elodine-gift-7.title: *John clutches the letter and tears form in his eyes* My sister... ah...

elodine-gift-8.title: In all honesty... I'm lost. I've searched endlessly through the forest to no avail. It seems that there is no clear path out of this vision of the past.

options.text: I made it in easy enough...

elodine-gift-9.title: Easy to enter, yes! But easy to get lost and... scared... of those mystical creatures.

options.text: The babbling ones or the aggressive ones?

elodine-gift-10.title: BOTH. The Babbling ones frustrate and prevent me from sleeping. The aggressive ones are - of course - actually dangerous. I'd love to return home but I simply can't.

options.text: Wait... is this a kill quest?

elodine-gift-11.title: A 'kill quest'? Maybe. If you can take out 15 of those aggressive creatures it might buy me enough time to run back to my sister!

elodine-gift-13.title: It's done? OKAY. I'm gonna go for a runner. Here, take this note to the village in the North. Tell em' JOHNNY'S GOING HOME.

elodine-gift-14.title: Yes! The descendants of the cult of Elodine or something. Bunch of weirdos, but they've been sending people down daily to feed me. I daren't venture up there myself.

elodine-village-2.title: To Elodine, the goddess of the sun. This area is a gift from her, you know?

elodine-village-3.title: ... hm, I suppose so. But she wouldn't turn her back on us. She is still here, channelled through the light-giving mushrooms and creatures of the forest.

elodine-gift-16.title: John is... moving on. Good. I'm not sure why he didn't come to us in this village.

options.text: He was... sort of a static individual.

elodine-gift-17.title: And yet we reached him safe and sound every single day. I bet he hasn't even moved, yet!

options.text: Maybe not. So who are you?

elodine-gift-18.title: Indeed. Many seem to be in this strange world.

elodine-gift-19.title: My name is Mortus. I know what you're thinking: 'Why would your parents name you DEATH but in Latin?' They weren't particularly clever.

options.text: There are more than a few strange naming conventions in our world.

elodine-gift-20.title: Well... our placenames are set by the gods. They are divine in their own odd ways.

elodine-gift-21.title: There are many. Those who create music, those who create land, those who create life... then there are those that write the stories that some of us choose to believe. Easier to believe in a sun god than a god of gods, you know?

options.text: You make it sound like fiction!

elodine-gift-22.title: I'm an adventurer of sorts. No doubt our paths will cross several times in our existence. I once ran the Explorer's Guild, I once was a servant to the King... and now I'm here, expositing information to you.

elodine-gift-23.title: A land beyond time. Once our whole world looked like this: magical and free. But then the bad times came. Even this small pocket dimension - a vision of a lost reality - has fallen to corruption.

options.text: I think I was attacked by that corruption on the way here...

elodine-gift-24.title: Fiction? Perhaps. Sometimes this life feels more like a cosmic game... where the gods regularly make things easier and harder and introduce new elements to existence... and we just accept it.

elodine-gift-25.title: This village is a shrine to her gift. Elodine. Few remember that name... fewer still understand it. They say that she gave life to all of us but I don't believe it. Nono, we are beings of a cosmic game outside of our reality... perhaps even in a 3 dimensional space.

elodine-gift-26.title: Consider me your expositor of information others may be too lazy to establish properly.

elodine-gift-27.title: Funny how in this world every step leads to danger... and yet civilians appear to live a peaceful existence.

options.text: You make it sound like fiction!

elodine-blacksmith-wife-3.title: Forgive my tone... it's just that memories of our past tragedies are still fresh in the mind.

elodine-blacksmith-wife-4.title: My husband... he gave his life for my escape. I maintain this Anvil and Furnace in his memory.

elodine-blacksmith-wife-5.title: Revenge is the only way. I would trade his only remaining posession - 20 of these 'Old World Crystals' - if revenge could be found.

options.text: I could set free the ghosts of the old village?

elodine-blacksmith-wife-6.title: See that it is done, and the crystals are yours.

elodine-blacksmith-wife-7.title: It is done. And now, my husband may rest. Thank you.

elodine-blacksmith-wife-1.title: An adventurer comes to town... where were you when the last village got attacked?

options.text: Hey now! Getting here was not easy.

elodine-blacksmith-wife-2.title: We used to be based down in the south, but this viscious being of darkness took hold of our people and led them to their deaths. Now only their ghosts remain...

options.text: Oh... you made it out okay though?

mortus-explore-1.title: Not all who wander are lost... but there's a very good chance you will be if you decide to explore the seas.

options.text: I will keep that in mind.

mortus-explore-2.title: This world has gotten a lot bigger recently. But there isn't much out there. Not yet, anyway.

skeleton-prisoner-1.title: Friend... it is too late for me...

options.text: Cut that out! We got you!

skeleton-prisoner-2.title: My soul is bound here now. As the Skeleton armies fall, so do I... and when they re-emerge... as they always do... I will re-emerge with them.

skeleton-prisoner-3.title: You do not understand. I am bound here... my soul...

skeleton-prisoner-4.title: No fun indeed. But there is a glimmer of hope... the bone plants.

skeleton-prisoner-5.title: These green manifestations of Bone Hurt have sprung up from the grounds. It's why the king is so desperate to expand. It's why he'll overrun the villages and cities of this land as soon as he is able.

skeleton-prisoner-6.title: The King's only weakness: Bone Hurting Juice. Made from the ooze these plants give off and fragments of bone. With it you can banish him for quite some time.

options.text: Bigger than killing the party storming the castle?

keleton-guard-3.title: YOU DIE. I DIE. WE ALL COME BACK EVENTUALLY. BUT THIS WILL CURSE MY SOUL FOREVER.

keleton-guard-4.title: THE BONE PLANT MONSTER. HE IS LOOSE. HE WILL SPEW HIS GREEN OOZE EVERYWHERE. I AM TOO WEAK TO KILL! YOU MUST!

adventurer-class-1.title: This time I'm gonna become a Mage. Then I'll have fun zapping the rats in my dad's pub. Yeeeaahhhh...

adventurer-class-2.title: Uhm. I went up to the machine and got scared. They said I wouldn't be able to hold heavy swords anymore. I lift, bro!

adventurer-class-3.title: I'm not old enough to use the machine yet. But when I do... I'm gonna be the STRONGEST of them all! RAAAAH!

class-mage.title: The Mages take advantage of this world's pool of Mana to smite their foes and assist their allies. What we lack in hardware we make up for in knowledge!

options.text: A path of magic sounds interesting...

class-warrior.title: MUSCLE... STEEL... ... ... MUSCLE ... FIGHT ... The WARRIORS HAVE IT ALL!

class-stoic.title: Stoicism is about resistance to pain. Accepting it as a fact of life. Then using that pain to be the very last to fall in battle. We take on the cuts and bruises that others wouldn't dream of. It is a discipline.

class-scientist.title: Just uh... step up to the machine and, uh, uh, press the right button and... everything should go.... just fine. Yup. Yep. Just fine.

mr-bones-1.title: Ahoy there! I'm Mr Bones and this is my pumpkin patch.

mr-bones-2.title: ... I just told you, pal. Mr. Bones. At your service!

mr-bones-3.title: I literally just said. Like, literally, the very last thing I said to you. I AM MR BONES. THIS IS MY PUMPKIN PATCH. Sheesh.

mr-bones-4.title: You shouldn't. Unless, that is, you like free stuff!

mr-bones-5.title: GOOD! Because when I say FREE I mean PLEASE GO AND KILL THINGS FOR ME.

options.text: Heard that one before. Kill what?

mr-bones-6.title: According to god's calendar it is a month of spookiness. The creator has placed demons within your world. Demons that drop fanciful chocolate. Fanciful chocolate that allows us BONIES to awaken from the dead and grow our pumpkins. We're too weak to fight the demons on our own... but you could!

options.text: That is some beefy exposition. What do I get?

mr-bones-7.title: Go into the patch and speak to my associates. No doubt they'll trade all sorts of STUFF for the Coveted Candy you bring them. Be quick, though, we'll be back in the ground once the rift has closed!

slasher-fan-1.title: I BET you want to look like me. And you CAN! In exchange for Coveted Candy. Delicious, sweet, life-giving, Coveted Candy. MMMMMM.

bat-tamer.title: Do you like my Bats? I can give you one if you want. Friendly little fella. For a little bit of that delicious sweet COVETED CANDY. Mmmm yes.

river-priest-1.title: An outsider? Stay close to stable ground, friend.

river-priest-2.title: We sent out for the Guards. They ventured into the Foglands to try and put a stop to the marshy expansion... but then they came back, distraught, and are drinking their lives away.

river-priest-3.title: Well... prayer didn't work, I can tell you that much. I thought that perhaps standing here would put the fear of God into them but... nah, it just made them drink even MORE.

options.text: This is just like that one book about wizards

maze-chalice-1.title: *The chalice glows and pulsates with light*

options.text: Well... I may as well grab this.

old-man-1.title: Do you think it appropriate to enter my home without warning like this?

options.text: No-one else complains when I do that. Why do you?

old-man-2.title: It is okay, child. I have simply not spoken to anyone for many years.

old-man-3.title: Do they not? Oh how society has changed in my many years of solitude. I haven't left this room in many years, you see.

old-man-4.title: It's the only way I can stay aware of my assets. The last time I ventured outside I went for a stroll... and I lost it... my most prized posession.

old-man-5.title: A magical chalice. YES, THAT'S RIGHT, MAGIC!

options.text: Woaaahhh magic that is totally a new concept too me. Please go on.
Magic is everywhere these days you crazy old man. Touch grass.

old-man-6.title: IT'S TRUE! Once there were wizards all across the land. But then there was a war... *he looks off, trying hard to remember*

old-man-7.title: And so, it seems, is arrogance. You should respect your elders.

options.text: Yeah yeah. So... this posession of yours?

old-man-8.title: A great & magical chalice I won in a contest. When combined with... this... *he hands you a staff* ... and a sprinkling of Old World magic ... it'll create the most powerful staff in all the land. The Elder Staff.

options.text: Cheers. Now off to find that chalice...

trainee-wizard-1.title: *The wizard aims their staff carefully over the river* ... Oh! Hey there.

rainee-wizard-2.title: Oh good heavens no! I am learning to cast fireballs by shooting them off at the bandits over the river.

river-priest-quest-1.title: Ah! My box of gear. This was meant to be used to help equip the guards but.. . er... they're not in the right frame of mind.

keleton-guard-5.title: WELL. WELL. WELL. I WOULD KILL YOU NOW, BUT GIVEN YOU DESTROYED THAT BIG THING... PERHAPS NOT. BUT WILL YOU ALSO LEAVE ME BE? IN RETURN, AND IN THANKS, I GIVE YOU THIS FREAKY BAT THING. IT FOLLOWS ME EVERYWHERE. NOW IT WILL FOLLOW YOU.
